name: 07505 · Paterson, NJ
findings: ZIP 07505 (Paterson) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07505 (Paterson) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07505 (Paterson) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 10.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
